executive_summary: The authorized exercise validated monitoring coverage and response coordination. Draft coordination contact: analyst@example.test.

findings.title: Administrative authentication visibility
findings.summary: Monitoring identified repeated administrative authentication activity and enabled a timely operator response.
findings.recommendation: Centralize administrative authentication logs and alert on unusual source-to-asset combinations.

findings.title: Service account review cadence
findings.summary: A synthetic service credential appeared in evidence collected during the approved test window.
findings.recommendation: Review service account use, ownership, and rotation on a documented schedule.

detection_recommendations: Alert on bursts of failed and successful administrative authentication from the same source.
Correlate process creation with network connections on high-value servers.
Review privileged service-account activity outside approved maintenance windows.
successes: Operators paused activity when the monitoring team requested validation.
Both endpoint and gateway exports used stable UTC timestamps.
failures: One JSONL record was malformed and required source-side correction.
The database alias was not represented in the asset inventory.
tool_gaps: The collector intentionally does not infer hostname aliases.
